title.value: Willingness to engage in shared decision making: Impact of an educational intervention for resident physicians (SDM-FM)
title.justification: The title accurately represents the study's focus on evaluating the impact of an educational intervention on the willingness of resident physicians to engage in shared decision making (SDM).
title.quote: Willingness to engage in shared decision making: Impact of an educational intervention for resident physicians (SDM-FM)

extractions.description: The paper evaluates the impact of a two-hour educational intervention on the willingness of Family Medicine residents to engage in shared decision making (SDM) in preventive health care. The willingness was measured at two time points before and after the intervention, revealing a small but statistically significant increase in willingness, driven by increased confidence in SDM skills in clinical practice.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on educational interventions and health care practices related to shared decision making, with no direct mention or focus on Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Objectives: We know little about the willingness of Family Medicine (FM) residents to engage in shared decision making (SDM). Thus, we evaluated the willingness of FM residents to engage in SDM, before and after an educational intervention.

primary_category.justification: The paper does not address any themes related to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development, focusing instead on a medical education topic.
primary_category.quote: Objectives: We know little about the willingness of Family Medicine (FM) residents to engage in shared decision making (SDM). Thus, we evaluated the willingness of FM residents to engage in SDM, before and after an educational intervention.

secondary_categories.justification: There are no secondary themes related to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development in this paper.
secondary_categories.quote: Methods: We delivered a 2-hour educational intervention consisting of a lecture and a workshop for FM residents on the topic of implementing SDM in preventive health care (SDM-FM).

primary_sub_category.justification: There is no specific sub-category applicable as the paper is outside the realm of Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development.
primary_sub_category.quote: We summarized the T1 scores and evaluated within-resident changes between T1 and T2 incorpoRATE scores.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: No secondary sub-categories apply as the paper does not relate to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: Results: At T1, 64 of 73 participating residents completed incorpoRATE; 43 (59%) were postgraduate year one (PGY1) and 21 were in their final year (PGY2).

applications.justification: The specific application discussed in the paper is the implementation of an educational intervention to increase willingness to engage in shared decision making among medical residents.
applications.quote: We delivered a 2-hour educational intervention consisting of a lecture and a workshop for FM residents on the topic of implementing SDM in preventive health care (SDM-FM).

new_primary_category.quote: Conclusions: Among FM residents, the willingness to engage in SDM varies greatly.
